name: An INPS pension in Germany (DE, taxedIn source, Italian tax credited)
workings: As inps-pension-german-national-taxed-in-source: the treaty gives Germany the INPS pension of a German national (not Italian), so Germany taxes it although the plan says Italy does; income tax before the credit T(23,537.2128) = 2,467.316394
Italy charged 1,500 on it (the planner's sourceTax, made up here); Germany credits it up to the German tax on that income (§34c Abs. 1)
The INPS pension's income: its taxable part 86% × 12,000 = 10,320.00 less its share of the 102 lump sum: 10,320 × 27,770.256 / 27,872.256 = 10,282.233412
Income tax after the credit 1,553.766189; no Soli (under the 20,350 limit)
